label: IonQ Forte - nominal medians

provenance.gates.gpi.fidelity: published: ~0.02% 1Q error, i.e. 99.98% (IonQ Forte / Forte Enterprise system page)
provenance.gates.gpi2.fidelity: published: as gpi (IonQ Forte system page)
provenance.gates.ms.fidelity: published: ~0.4% 2Q error, i.e. 99.6% (IonQ Forte / Forte Enterprise system page)
provenance.gates.zz.fidelity: assumed: equal to the published MS fidelity
provenance.readout.fidelity: published: ~0.5% SPAM error, i.e. 99.5% (IonQ Forte system page); applied as symmetric readout error
provenance.gates.gpi.duration_ns: assumed: 135 us is IonQ *Aria*'s single-qubit gate time (Azure Quantum IonQ page); no Forte figure is published
provenance.gates.ms.duration_ns: assumed: 600 us is IonQ *Aria*'s two-qubit gate time (Azure Quantum IonQ page); no Forte figure is published
provenance.readout.duration_ns: assumed: placeholder (no Forte readout time published)
provenance.coherence.t1_us: assumed: 10 s, lower end of the 10-100 s quoted for IonQ *Aria* (Azure Quantum IonQ page), not Forte
provenance.coherence.t2_us: assumed: 1 s, quoted for IonQ *Aria* (Azure Quantum IonQ page), not Forte
provenance.shot_overhead_us: unknown: per-shot overhead is not published; job-time estimates exclude it unless set
provenance.parallelism: assumed: one entangling gate at a time in a single ion chain sharing one motional bus (IonQ does not publish its gate parallelism)

note: Nominal device-median values for QPUTwin's noise and gate-duration models. Every field is tagged in 'provenance' as 'published' (with its source) or 'assumed' (placeholder typical of the technology class, NOT vendor data). Replace with a calibration snapshot via QPUTWIN_CALIBRATION before quoting results.
